授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
・This lecture requires students to have completed the courses of "Reaction Engineering," "Separation Engineering," and "Process Control" in the Department of Chemical Engineering, Faculty of Engineering in Kyushu University.
・Students should bring their own laptop, install a free process simulator.
・If you bring Mac PC, it is difficult to support to use and install this processs simulator.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 典型的な化学プラントの基本設計をプロセスシミュレータを利用して行うことにより，プロセス設計の基礎を修得する．
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）: Students will learn the fundamentals of process design by performing the basic design of typical chemical plant with the use of process simulator.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Process design, Reaction engineering, Separation engineering, Unit operation, Physical property estimation,, Optimum design
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件:
・This lecture requires students to have completed the courses of "Reaction Engineering," "Separation Engineering," and "Process Control" in the Department of Chemical Engineering, Faculty of Engineering.
・Students should bring their own laptop, install a free process simulator.
In order to use it, students already have to know the fundamental knowledge about the followings before the first lecture day:
- reactor types and these model (CSTR, PFR)
- various separation method and model (distillation tower, theoretical steps, membrane separation)
- gas-liquid equilibrium (activity coefficient, it's estimation model)
- etc.
